name: Cabinet
role: Sets strategic direction, focusing national attention on the highest-impact priorities.

name: National Planning Commission (NPC)
role: The central authority: coordinates delivery, tracks progress and tests whether reforms are working.

name: e-Delivery
role: The digital results-management platform and dashboards that consolidate and present performance across all institutions.

name: Ministry for Regional Administration and Local Government
role: Ensures consistency between local government implementation and national priorities; submits consolidated sub-national data to e-Delivery.

name: Sector Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs)
role: Own sector policy and implementation; submit validated sector performance data to e-Delivery.

name: Regional Secretariats (RSs)
role: Coordinate and validate sub-national data across their regions.

name: Local Government Authorities (LGAs)
role: Deliver at the local level and submit performance data to Regional Secretariats and e-Delivery dashboards.
